messages:
amy_sales: FYI AcmeCorp sent back redlines and say they will only issue a PO before the Order Form is countersigned. their asks: Net45, explicit PO->OrderForm reference, auditor access in DPA, and an HSM clause. POC blocked until PO arrives. they said PO today. link: https://acme.internal/redlines.pdf

sam_ops: @amy can we actually provision on PO-only? what changes to our flow if MSA not signed?

mike_billing: We can accept PO as trigger for billing but finance needs one of: (A) PO references OF number and billing entity + W-9 / VAT info; (B) prepayment equal to 30 days of estimated usage if MSA outstanding. Net45 ok once MSA countersigned or preauth set.

dan_legal: I reviewed redlines: they widened audit rights and added an HSM requirement. We should avoid broad auditor access. Suggest a "Provisional Use Addendum": limited time, limited audit scope (logs only for POC, via secure portal), PO must state "provisional access per Addendum" and expire if MSA unsigned in 30 days. I'll draft a narrow addendum; won't accept unlimited auditor access.

priya_sec: Security notes: SOC2 Type II summary available. HSM attestation: we don't publish a formal HSM attestation today. For regulated flows we can offer Private deployment with HSM integration but that's a separate project (~2-3 weeks). For POC I recommend: 1) disable exports, 2) short retention (14d), 3) no external key material export. That should reduce risk.

eve_pmc: PM note: customer POC needs data ingestion and real calls this week. timeline compressed. If PO is received today and we accept provisional addendum, we can start onboarding in ~5 business days (ops + infra). If they insist on HSM before POC, that's +3w.

amy_sales: Customer sample PO text they said they'll send: "PO# AC-2026-778, Net45, Bill to Redwood Inference, Inc, Ref: OF-2026-391". They said their legal will sign the PO today.

mike_billing: Once PO PDF arrives, send to billing@redwood.com with billing contact and tax id. If international, include VAT reg. We'll also need a billing contact email to map the PO to invoice flow.

dan_legal: Draft path: (1) Accept PO + Provisional Use Addendum (30d), (2) Addendum limits liability to trial credit cap, (3) DPA auditor access scoped to read-only log extract via our portal and only for POC entities, (4) HSM clause: note that HSM is available on Private deployment and encourage them to accept KMS placeholder for POC. I can produce the addendum redline and a short cover note for sales.

priya_sec: If we go this route, I need to provide a SOC2 summary and a short note on HSM road map to attach with RFP. I'll compile and upload in next 2 hours.

sam_ops: Ops implementation: To provision pre-MSA we will: lock retention to 14d, disable outbound exports, restrict user roles to POC team, and require customer to sign AUP for data. Provision ETA: 5 business days once PO + billing info received. Need infra approval for dedicated sandbox spinup.

amy_sales: Sounds good. I'll ask customer to include exact OF ref and billing contact on the PO. Also pushing them to accept the provisional addendum.

eve_pmc: Can we add a short operational checklist to the addendum? like retention, export off, and expiration date. Helps ops enforce config.

dan_legal: Yes I'll include a one-paragraph ops checklist as Exhibit A in the addendum. Keeps everything explicit.

amy_sales: Action items: Dan -> draft provisional addendum + Exhibit A by EOD; Mike -> confirm billing process and email template; Priya -> SOC2 summary + HSM note in 2h; Sam -> confirm infra slot for sandbox; Amy -> request PO PDF and billing contact from customer, push for OF ref in PO.

amy_sales: Customer replied: "PO will be sent today, referencing OF-2026-391. We will accept the Provisional Addendum language if provided." I'll post PO when it lands. :+1:

mike_billing: Received PO PDF? If so drop here and cc billing. We'll validate entity and tax info before invoicing.

priya_sec: Uploaded SOC2 summary to thread: https://redwood.docs/soc2-summary.pdf. HSM roadmap snippet attached in drive.

sam_ops: Infra approved sandbox slot next Wednesday. If PO arrives today we can start provisioning then. Required: PO PDF + billing contact + signed addendum or confirmation by email acknowledging provisional terms.

amy_sales: PO just arrived and uploaded: PO# AC-2026-778 (PDF). It references OF-2026-391 and Net45. Attaching now.

mike_billing: Got the PO PDF. Billing team will validate and set up invoice flow. Mike -> followup if tax/VAT missing.

dan_legal: Uploading redline of addendum now. If they accept, operations can proceed. If they push for broader auditor rights we escalate.

amy_sales: Thanks all, will update if customer counters on any addendum language.
